purpose: Teach: 顎/灸/セラピー/ブタ/歌劇/抱きしめ/アクセル/卓球

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんの顎が立派でらしたぞ
lines.en: You know, Gran, when your father was young, he had such a strong jawline.
lines.style: Soft, reaching back into memory. Tender smile in the voice. Slow measured pace, as if seeing the image clearly again. Warm and a little wistful on the name.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、お腰の痛みを灸で治されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and Grandpa, you had your back pain treated with moxibustion, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Gentle, affectionate correction—playfully redirecting his memory. Light, teasing warmth. As if she's heard this story before and loves him for telling it again. Soft landing on the 'dear.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、村の長老がセラピーをしてくださったぞ
lines.en: When I was young, Gran, the village elder did therapy for my back pain.
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact recollection. No self-pity, just stating what was. Patient rhythm. The voice of someone comfortable in his own history, not performing it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ブタ年生まれだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You were born in the Year of the Pig, weren't you, dear? That's what I remember.
lines.style: Warm, slightly teasing reminder. The rhythm of long companionship—she's reminding him of what he knows. Affectionate but firm, like a gentle correction that comes from knowing him completely.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと歌劇を見に行ったぞ
lines.en: When I was young, Gran, I went to see an opera with my father.
lines.style: Eyes distant. The pleasure of the memory moves through the words softly. Slower pace, almost reverent. Voice opens slightly on 'opera'—that was something special.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫さんを優しく抱きしめてらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you held your grandchildren so gently, didn't you, dear? I remember that so well.
lines.style: Tender and certain. She's naming something she watched him do, something that mattered. Soft, appreciative. The voice of someone proud of the man she's lived a life with.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、車のアクセルを踏み間違えるお父さんはいらしたぞ
lines.en: When I was young, Gran, my father would sometimes mix up the accelerator and the brake.
lines.style: Gentle amusement in the voice—a small, affectionate laugh at human frailty. Slow and warm. The fondness of remembering someone's flaws and loving them anyway.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、卓球の選手だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You were quite the table tennis player back then, weren't you, dear?
lines.style: Admiring, warm close. She's reaching for a different memory now—proud of him, playfully insisting on his own story. Soft and intimate, like the final word in a long, loving conversation. Trailing off slightly.
